headline: Cardinals Finalizing WR Marvin Harrison Jr. Trade
summary: 12:45pm: The Texans have been in “deep negotiations” with the Cardinals regarding Harrison, Schultz confirms, with “significant draft capital” involved. headline: Ravens Completed Cam Jurgens’ Physical In Philly Before Finalizing Trade
summary: The Ravens paid a hefty price to acquire center Cam Jurgens from the Eagles this week, a move that came with significant risk given his 2025 back surgery that could still have lingering effects. headline: Ravens are much different with and without Lamar Jackson
summary: As expected, given that he's week-to-week with an ankle injury, Ravens quarterback Lamar Jackson will miss Sunday night's game against the Falcons.

headline: Source: Odell Beckham Jr. joins Vikings roster, status unclear
summary: While the Vikings elevated receiver Odell Beckham Jr. from the practice squad for Sunday's game, a source said, it's not yet decided if he'll play.

headline: Chargers Place QB Trey Lance, T Trevor Penning On IR; Activate Two From IR
summary: Attrition continues to provide hardship for the still winless Chargers. Los Angeles announced today that, while they were able to activate fullback/defensive tackle Scott Matlock and offensive lineman Branson Taylor from injured reserve, they will be taking the roster spots of quarterback Trey Lance and offensive tackle Trevor Penning, who are being placed on IR.
